platforms.name: NoCopyrightSounds (NCS) Official LabelRadar Demo Submission Route
platforms.country: United Kingdom / global electronic music label and creator-music platform
platforms.feeAmount: NCS does not state a mandatory demo fee on its official contact page. LabelRadar is a third-party account and submission platform that may expose free allowances and optional paid features; current access and pricing must be reviewed manually.
platforms.manualReviewReason: NCS explicitly directs demo submissions to its LabelRadar portal, but the portal loads dynamically and creates an account, login, terms, privacy, submission-credit and possible optional-payment boundary. A human must authenticate through the authorized portal, inspect the current campaign status, pricing, submission limits, rights and consent terms, verify that the selected MarcsMusic track fits NCS's electronic catalogue, and submit manually. NCS's general-enquiry route must not be repurposed for demo delivery.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-13 from NCS's official contact page and music library. The contact page labels the external destination 'Demo Submissions' and says to submit music to NCS on LabelRadar. The NCS library was active with releases listed as three and four days old and includes drum-and-bass, dubstep, bass music, breakbeat, garage, house, future bass and related electronic genres. The LabelRadar portal returned only a dynamic loading shell during passive review, so live fields, account requirements, campaign availability, submission credits, optional payments, rights text and anti-abuse controls were not exercised. No public music-submission email was exposed or inferred. No account, login, form, track, payment, CAPTCHA or email workflow was used, and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox or deliverability probe was performed.

platforms.name: UKF / Pilot First-Party Bass Music Demo Form Route
platforms.country: United Kingdom / London global bass-music media and record-label group
platforms.feeAmount: UKF states no submission fee, account, login or payment requirement on the official demo page.
platforms.manualReviewReason: UKF explicitly invites tracks for release on UKF or Pilot through the first-party form, but the live form fields, accepted link or file formats, upload limits, rights declarations, privacy consent and any runtime anti-spam controls were not exposed in passive rendering. A human must inspect the current form, choose the appropriate UKF or Pilot fit, verify ownership and release status, approve all metadata and terms, and submit manually. UKF explicitly says demos must not be sent to its support address.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-13 from UKF's official demo, contact and releases pages. The demo page says artists who are ready to send music for a label release should complete the form and asks them not to use the support address. UKF's releases page showed current releases dated 8 July 2026 and 9 July 2026 and exposes relevant categories including drum-and-bass, jungle, dubstep, 140, color bass, riddim, house, garage, bassline, trap, UKG and wave. No submission CAPTCHA, login or mandatory payment was confirmed from the passive page, but the embedded form did not expose its full current fields or controls and remains manual. No public submission email was published or inferred. No form, music, file, link, email, cookie-consent action or anti-spam control was submitted or bypassed, and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox or deliverability probe was performed.

platforms.name: Gravitas Recordings First-Party Unreleased Demo Submission Form Route
platforms.country: United States / Austin global bass, world-electronic and downtempo label
platforms.feeAmount: Gravitas states no submission fee, account, login or payment requirement on the official demo page.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Gravitas accepts unreleased music through its first-party form and prefers a mastered private SoundCloud playlist share link, but submission requires artist and personal contact details, disclosure of whether the music was sent to other labels, an artist statement, optional social profiles and acceptance of any live privacy or anti-spam controls. A human must verify the tracks are unreleased and mastered, confirm the SoundCloud share permissions, review all current consent and rights text, decide whether simultaneous label submissions are acceptable, approve personal data and submit manually.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-13 from Gravitas Recordings' official demos, contact and music pages. The demo form says every demo is listened to, requests only unreleased music, prefers private SoundCloud playlist share links, asks whether the music has been sent to other labels, and requests artist name, real name, email, an explanation of fit and optional social profiles. The contact page separately directs demo senders to the demos page and says mastered private SoundCloud links should be used there. The official music catalogue exposes a 2026 release section and strong world-bass, bass, downtempo, global, organic-electronic and experimental alignment. No public demo mailbox was published. No form, SoundCloud link, personal data, login, payment or CAPTCHA workflow was used, and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox or deliverability probe was performed.
